Additionally, educational institutions contribute to feelings of harassment and social exclusion. While some visibility fosters a degree of acceptance, it simultaneously increases the risk of backlash and surveillance for queer communities in the region.

title: 'Sometimes dynastic politics has its benefits': Akhilesh on how 5 family MPs helped SP

We also have several Muslim MPs, and some staunch socialists, so our numbers would not decrease," he said.

title: MP: One newborn dies, 2 suffer burn injuries after warmer machine catches fire
description: A newborn died and two others were injured after a warmer machine caught fire in Chhindwara's NICU. The incident occurred early Saturday morning due to sparks from the machine's filament. Hospital staff quickly extinguished the blaze using firefighting equipment. The injured babies were transferred to Jabalpur for advanced medical care. An inquiry has been initiated to determine the exact cause of the fire.

description: A former Meta manager filed a lawsuit alleging wrongful termination after objecting to an immigration letter. James Tillinghast claimed the letter overstated an employee's contributions and responsibilities. He also alleged Meta provided preferential immigration support to certain Chinese national employees. Tillinghast believes his dismissal was retaliation for raising these concerns. The lawsuit names Meta Platforms and a manager as defendants.

title: K'taka assembly passes apartment Bill: From ownership to redevelopment, rules defined
description: The Karnataka Assembly has passed a landmark bill to regulate apartment ownership and management effectively. This legislation lays the groundwork for Residents' Welfare Associations and offers guidance on managing common spaces. It also introduces a multi-tiered dispute resolution system. For redevelopment initiatives, a majority of 75% owner consent is now required, with owners who decline receiving double their property's assessed value.

title: 7-storey under construction building collapses in Hyderabad, 2 dead
description: In Madhapur, a seven-storey building that was still under construction collapsed tragically on Saturday afternoon. Search and rescue teams are actively working to locate any individuals who may be trapped beneath the rubble. Officials have sadly confirmed the death of at least two individuals due to the collapse. The building was reportedly erected on a cramped lot, and construction had previously ceased.

title: IIT Delhi student dies after jumping from sixth-floor campus building
description: A 31-year-old M.Sc. Physics student at IIT Delhi died Saturday morning. Police received a call about a student jumping from a building on campus. The injured student was taken to the hospital and declared brought dead. Investigators found no apparent injuries other than those from the fall. Police are examining the student's mobile phone and counselling records.

Four days after that win, the visitors will be back in action in Colombo for the second and final Test. India will be pleased with most aspects of their performance in Galle, but Kuldeep's form remains one of the major talking points.

She sustained a concussion, leg bruises, and a jaw injury from the collision. Police have registered a case and are actively searching for the fleeing motorcyclist. Activists noted the absence of speedbreakers due to Metro construction work.

As job losses become more frequent, public concerns escalate, with many Americans fearing that AI will diminish economic prospects. In response, companies are now positioning workforce adjustments as a transformation of roles rather than outright job elimination.

The assault occurred at his home in Delhi after his wife summoned her family members.  Police have detained four individuals in connection with the brutal incident and are investigating.  The case is being registered under sections relating to murder and common intention.

Strained relations over Manas Bajpayi's sister, Sheeba, also contributed to the marital discord.  Police are investigating the killings as a pre-planned sequence of events.  Digital evidence and witness statements are being analyzed to establish the motive.

title: Revanth Reddy not first CM to be denied MEA nod for foreign visit
description: Several opposition chief ministers and ministers have faced foreign travel clearance denials.  Telangana CM Revanth Reddy's recent rejection is not an isolated incident.  Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann and West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee also experienced similar rejections.  Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal and Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan were also denied foreign trip approvals.  These rejections highlight the MEA's role in granting political clearance for official visits.

title: £170,000 annexe built for disabled daughter faces demolition after complaints
description: A mother who spent £170,000 building a two-storey annexe for her disabled daughter could now be forced to demolish it after losing a planning appeal. Clair Birch, 59, built the one-bedroom annexe in the garden of her semi-detached home in Worcester. She said the building was designed to give her daughter more independence and meet her specific needs.

title: Congress’s renewed youth outreach: How CJP has forced parties to course correct
description: Student protests at Jantar Mantar have prompted political parties to rethink their youth engagement strategies. The Congress party is now focusing on youth issues and expanding its outreach programs nationwide. Rahul Gandhi's recent actions highlight the party's renewed commitment to addressing student concerns. The Congress Working Committee has proposed an education-to-employment roadmap for young people. This shift reflects a broader effort to regain support among the nation's youth.

title: Brazilian mother and daughter built seven-bedroom home from 8,000 glass bottles
description: A visionary mother and daughter duo transformed sustainability into an art form, building a seven-room home out of more than 8,000 recycled glass bottles. Incorporating elements like reclaimed wood and toothpaste tubes, this remarkable endeavor addresses the dual challenges of beach pollution and housing shortages in Brazil. Named the Salt House, it stands as a sustainable residence and an inspiring venue for community education on environmental responsibility and innovative reuse.
